remarks: An extraordinary private estate encompassing 77.87 acres, this meticulously maintained 4-bed, 2.5-bath residence offers an exceptional blend of refined living, natural beauty, and unparalleled versatility. A hunter’s paradise, this property offers wildlife, 2 expansive ponds, and trails winding throughout the property. One pond reaches 12 ft deep, while mature apple and pear trees and blueberry bushes provide an abundance of natural food for wildlife. Bald eagles can be seen across the street. With wooded areas, open acreage, and land extending on both sides of Utley Rd, this secluded property offers exceptional opportunities for hunting, hiking, wildlife observation, and outdoor recreation. 2 massive pole barns offer ample space for machinery, recreational vehicles, and gear. One barn features an insulated room, concrete flooring with built-in drainage, a Lift Master garage door opener, and large double doors. The front deck features a private enclosed hot tub and double entry doors leading into an impressive foyer. It opens into the great room, where soaring ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and a centrally positioned wood-burning stove with a 3-flue chimney, surrounded by a stone wall, is the focal point. Two sets of sliding glass doors provide direct access the front deck and hot tub. Flowing effortlessly into the media room with hardwood floors and floor-to-ceiling windows, continuing into the beautifully appointed kitchen. Maple cabinetry and a breakfast bar complement the adjoining dining area, which features sliding glass doors to a massive covered porch. The first floor features a large laundry room, a half bath, an office featuring a large picture window and Travertine marble flooring that enhances the foyer, kitchen, and dining room. The primary suite offers hardwood floors and a California Closet, while the luxurious ensuite bath showcases marble trim, porcelain floors, ceramic tile walls, and a walk-in closet. Upstairs, an open loft overlooks the great room. 3 additional bedrooms feature hardwood floors and California Closets. A full bath and conveniently located hallway linen closet, also outfitted as a California Closet, complete the second floor.
